custom_expected:
1. The panel button still works on a narrow window: it is not hidden, greyed out or unresponsive below 960 pixels, and clicking it shows the left panel by hand even at that width.
2. The panel stays as you set it while you keep working at that width - moving around the page does not undo your choice.
3. Your choice only stops applying when the window is resized back across the 960 pixel mark; at that point the page goes back to deciding for itself whether the panel is shown.

Run this test as written and mark it on what you actually find. When it was last checked, on 11 August 2026, the Schedule toolbar had no panel button at all - the button furthest to the left above the grid was Today - so on that build steps 1 to 8 cannot be carried out and this test FAILS. Mark it failed if that is still what you see. If the button is there and behaves as described, mark it passed.

custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Your role has the Schedule: View permission.
3. You are on the Schedule page.
custom_steps:
1. Make the browser window narrower than 960 pixels wide. (The panel folding itself away on its own at that width is checked by a separate test - this test is about the button.)
2. Find the panel button at the far-left end of the row of buttons above the grid and click it.
3. Keep the window at that narrow width and carry on using the page - click a couple of dates in the small month calendar and scroll the grid.
4. Now make the browser window wider again, back over 960 pixels.
